header: Sports headlines, from the feeds of ESPNcricinfo, The Hindu Sport and BBC Sport. I sort each story by its own words into INDIA India or an Indian team, player or league is directly in it (the national teams, the IPL, the ISL, the Ranji Trophy, the BCCI ...); WORLD EVENTS a major world event, with or without India (a World Cup, the Olympics, the Asian or Commonwealth Games, the Champions Trophy, a Grand Slam, Formula 1 ...); OTHER everything else. A story can be both. These are headlines with links to the publisher's page; no free, steady live-score feed exists, and I do not let a card pretend to be one.
